tools.name: pingboard_get_company
tools.description: Get the company the service account belongs to (name, subdomain, terminology). API: GET /companies/my_company.

tools.name: pingboard_list_users
tools.description: List users (name, email, phone, job title, start date, reports-to id, group ids, custom fields). API: GET /users. Filters match exactly.

tools.name: pingboard_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with groups, custom fields and linked accounts. API: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: pingboard_search_users
tools.description: Search users by a free-text query (name, job title, skills, interests). API: GET /search/users?q=.

tools.name: pingboard_list_groups
tools.description: List groups (teams, departments and other groups): name, description, type, member count. API: GET /groups.

tools.name: pingboard_get_group
tools.description: Get one group by id, with its member user ids. API: GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: pingboard_search_groups
tools.description: Search groups by a free-text query. API: GET /search/groups?q=.

tools.name: pingboard_list_statuses
tools.description: List status entries (out-of-office and other status messages) with their time period. API: GET /statuses.

tools.name: pingboard_get_status
tools.description: Get one status entry by id. API: GET /statuses/{id}.

tools.name: pingboard_list_status_types
tools.description: List the status types a company can use (name, slug, colour, availability). API: GET /status_types.

tools.name: pingboard_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom profile fields of the company (name, field type, valid values, visibility). API: GET /custom_fields.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pingboard_list_users, pingboard_list_statuses · Public sink: pingboard_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pingboard_list_users, pingboard_list_statuses · Public sink: pingboard_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
